steps.message:
The price test passes again. I haven't committed the change.

The cause was the last commit, "price: tidy up" (`ff25461`). It changed the multiplier in `bin/price` from 90 to 95, which gave a 5% discount instead of 10%. The code comment, the README and the tests all specify 10% off, so I changed it back to `base * 90 / 100`.

I assumed 10% is the intended discount. If the business meant to change it to 5%, the tests, README and comment need updating instead. Check with whoever made that commit before you release.
